status: Implemented and checked in local scripted preview
background: Native cloud/castle source wired into mobile portrait/landscape base play and entry screens; 4px reference blur. Shared portrait source fitted into landscape; dedicated landscape source not acquired. Desktop terrace and bonus mode art preserved.

motion.tile: Pad, border and symbol travel as one cell. Empty pads vanish after removal.
motion.clock: One shared RAF timestamp for tile gravity and Spine contact; CSS symbol-only travel disabled.
motion.contact: Starts at column delay + travel duration; Normal240ms / Fast160ms / Turbo80ms. Phase waits through last contact.
motion.exit: Matches incoming left-to-right reel stagger at all speeds, instead of3ms column delay.
motion.coldLoad: Symbol rig/atlas decoded before reveal wave begins; no elapsed landing while textures load.
motion.skip: Same wave origin; airborne travel shortened, future contacts accelerated; settled contacts never restarted.
motion.resize: Row pitches remeasured by bounded ResizeObserver while travelling; observer/ticker cleaned up on phase change/unmount.

validation.normal: 65 DOM samples span exit/drop/win; zero Spine land poses on displaced tiles; no inner CSS travel transforms.
validation.fast: 45 DOM samples span exit/drop/win; zero early land poses.
validation.turbo: 35 DOM samples span drop/win/removal; zero early land poses.
validation.skip: Space during spinning sets data-skipped=true; selected speed stays Normal.
validation.landscape: Final exit screenshot and DOM show left columns displaced130px, column3~51px, column4~7px, column5 still. Pads and symbols share the cell transform.
validation.money: Dev-only scripted preview; no real wagers/transactions
